question.text: Section 12 / 12AA of PMLA obligates reporting entities (including PMS) to:

answer.text: Maintain client records and report CTR/STR to FIU-IND

explanation.text: The Logic: S.12/12AA: maintain records, perform KYC, file CTR/STR with FIU-IND (not publicly). The Trap: Prosecution is government's role; public-share violates privacy. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV central content. Manager's Pro-Tip: Designate a PMLA Officer (Principal Officer) and a Compliance Officer — SEBI inspections verify these designations exist.
